fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Game working memory kept in cartridge RAM (screen, sprite, menu and play state). Not part of the save record. Wiped to zero at power-on when no valid save is found.
fields.evidence: code 4000:0000 (power-on wipe if check 4000:ed67 fails); diffs between boot and later play (changes every frame)

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Save signature text BASSSAVE. Checked at power-on.
fields.evidence: code 4000:edb5 writes it, 4000:ed67 compares against ROM text at 4000:edad; appears only when the game saves

fields.name: copy A status
fields.meaning: 1 = valid save. 0 = erased. 2 = written only if leftover register garbage is nonzero (never seen in normal play); a copy with 2 fails its own check value and is never loaded.
fields.evidence: code 4000:edb5 (tests DH from the previous routine's return, always 0), 4000:ed50 (0), 4000:ee08 loads only when 1; both natural saves = 1

fields.name: player name
fields.meaning: Name typed at New Game, up to 5 full-width characters, 2 bytes each. Unused positions hold the blank mark (81 51).
fields.evidence: code 4000:cd86/4000:cf3a write the name buffer; both natural saves hold the name entered on the name-entry screen

fields.name: name tail
fields.meaning: Always 0x00; the end mark 0x0E is written right after the last character inside the 10 bytes above.
fields.evidence: code 4000:cd86 clears it, writes 0x0E at 2*length; both natural saves = 00

fields.name: box setting
fields.meaning: Set to 3 at New Game; no other code touches it.
fields.evidence: code 4000:93da init; both natural saves = 3

fields.name: tackle box lures
fields.meaning: One byte per tackle box slot: which lure is in it (0-15); FF = empty slot.
fields.evidence: code 4000:8615/4000:85a0 add, 4000:939b clears on removal, 4000:93da init; second natural save gained lure 1 in slot 1 after adding it on the lure-box screen

fields.name: tackle box colors
fields.meaning: Parallel per-slot byte for the same 48 slots: lure color (0-7); FF = empty.
fields.evidence: code 4000:939b clears both lists together, 4000:93da init, 4000:8c33 picker; second natural save gained color 0 in slot 1

fields.name: owned lure colors
fields.meaning: One bitmask byte per lure: bit i = color i owned. The color picker only accepts owned colors; winning a contest unlocks one more.
fields.evidence: code 4000:8c33 tests the bit (an unowned color cannot be confirmed, observed on the color screen), 4000:bdb7 sets a random bit after a contest win, 4000:93da init

fields.name: rod flags
fields.meaning: Four tackle-availability flags, all 1.
fields.evidence: code 4000:93da init 1, read by rod picker 4000:9a6c; both natural saves = 1,1,1,1

fields.name: unknown flag
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; bit 0 selects between two graphics tables on a drawing routine.
fields.evidence: code 4000:9934 tests bit 0; writer not found

fields.name: equipped rod
fields.meaning: Selected rod/tackle index (0 = POWER LIGHT on the tackle screen).
fields.evidence: code 4000:9640 stores the rod-picker result, fishing code 4000:2d26 reads it; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: equipped lure
fields.meaning: Lure id the rod is rigged with.
fields.evidence: code 4000:9640/4000:8b80 store it, fishing code reads it; second natural save = 1 after rigging lure 1

fields.name: equipped color
fields.meaning: Color id the rod is rigged with.
fields.evidence: code 4000:9640/4000:8b80 store it; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: lure rig
fields.meaning: Extra rig/option for lures that need one (0-4); 0 = none.
fields.evidence: code 4000:9640/4000:8b80 store the 4000:9af0 result, fishing code 4000:3a7e compares 0-4; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: box cursor mode
fields.meaning: Lure-box screen entry mode (left over from the last box screen).
fields.evidence: code 4000:8615 stores entry value; both natural saves = 1

fields.name: box cursor slot
fields.meaning: Last selected tackle box slot.
fields.evidence: code 4000:8615 stores it; 0 then 1 across the two natural saves

fields.name: box counter
fields.meaning: Add/remove counter: 1 at New Game, +1 per added lure (even when overwriting a filled slot), -1 per removal; can drift from the true filled count.
fields.evidence: code 4000:93da init 1, 4000:85a0 increments, 4000:939b decrements; 2 then 3 across the two natural saves

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; no code references it.
fields.evidence: no direct reference seen; likely unused

fields.name: mode flags
fields.meaning: Game mode bits: 0x80 tournament, 0x40 lecture, 0x20 contest, low 2 bits contest division. Picks which catch-record size value ranks the lists.
fields.evidence: code 4000:c97d/4000:cb04/4000:d4cd set bits, 4000:b08e tests them; lecture save = 0x40, free-mode save = 0x00

fields.name: contest day
fields.meaning: Day index inside a multi-day contest (0-2; tournament uses 3-5).
fields.evidence: code main flow 4000:0134 clears/increments/compares with 3, 4000:de55 sets (flags&3)+3; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: contest wins
fields.meaning: Championship bits, one per division, set when a contest is won.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d55b OR-accumulates 1<<(flags&3), celebrates at 0x07; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: contest in progress
fields.meaning: 1 when saved between days of a multi-day contest, 0 after the final results.
fields.evidence: code 4000:0134 sets it before the mid-contest save, title menu 4000:c77e resumes the contest from it; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: bonus flag
fields.meaning: Always 1: set at New Game and never cleared, which disables a 10%-chance bonus event while fishing.
fields.evidence: code 4000:93da/4000:939b/4000:85a0 only ever store 1, 4000:46d6 gates the bonus on bit 0; both natural saves = 1

fields.name: day value
fields.meaning: Contest day number (tournament: a random 0-3); stored into each catch record.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d4cd sets it, 4000:af5d copies it to record byte +9; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: start hour
fields.meaning: Outing start hour: 6, 10 or 16.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d4cd/4000:b2c6 derive it from the time slot; map screen shows 6:00 in both natural saves

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Only ever written as 0.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d458/4000:d4cd/4000:b2c6 zero it; likely unused

fields.name: weather
fields.meaning: Weather for the outing: 0-2 (1 = cloudy, shown as the map icon in both natural saves).
fields.evidence: code 4000:d4cd/4000:b2c6 randomize 0-2, 4000:af5d copies it to record byte +11

fields.name: map point
fields.meaning: Selected fishing point on the lake map.
fields.evidence: code 4000:9fd8 stores the point-picker result, 4000:2a90 uses it; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: map index
fields.meaning: Lake index 0-4 (0 = wild pond; free and lecture outings always use 0).
fields.evidence: code 4000:d4cd randomizes 0-4 for contests, 4000:b240 clears it otherwise; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: time slot
fields.meaning: Time of day 0/1/2 (morning/midday/evening), matching start hour 6/10/16.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d4cd/4000:de55 map it both ways with the hour; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: best-5 total
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the first size value over the 5 best catches.
fields.evidence: code f000:de30 sums it, f000:e272/4000:dbd3 display it; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: contest total
fields.meaning: 16-bit running contest total across days.
fields.evidence: code f000:e240 clears, f000:e648 accumulates, f000:e272 displays; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: catch count
fields.meaning: Catches this outing (incremented when a catch qualifies for a record list).
fields.evidence: code 4000:b08e increments, cleared by outing setup; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: tournament total
fields.meaning: 16-bit tournament running total.
fields.evidence: code f000:de5d writes, f000:e738 compares, 4000:dbd3 displays; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Always 0x0E (the same value the game uses as a text end mark).
fields.evidence: code 4000:d458 init; text renderer f000:e376 scans for 0x0E nearby

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves.
fields.evidence: only string-scan references nearby

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; no code references it.
fields.evidence: no direct reference seen; likely unused

fields.name: score baseline
fields.meaning: 16-bit tournament baseline, constant 700, shown on the tournament results screen.
fields.evidence: code 4000:d458 sets 700, never changed, f000:e272 displays it; both natural saves = 700

fields.name: tournament cumulative
fields.meaning: 16-bit cumulative tournament total.
fields.evidence: code f000:e240 clears, f000:e648 accumulates, f000:e272 displays; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; no code references it.
fields.evidence: no direct reference seen; likely unused

fields.name: standings buffer
fields.meaning: 10 words copied to the results screen; exact entries unknown.
fields.evidence: code f000:e272 copies them to the display, f000:e351 writes; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: results table
fields.meaning: 20 words copied to the results screen; exact entries unknown.
fields.evidence: code f000:e240 clears, f000:e272 copies them to the display; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; no code references it.
fields.evidence: no direct reference seen; likely unused

fields.name: tournament phase
fields.meaning: 16-bit phase marker (6 during the tournament day, 5 after).
fields.evidence: code 4000:d892 stores 6, 4000:dabd stores 5, 4000:ddf3 reads; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: won flag
fields.meaning: 1 = the contest/tournament was won.
fields.evidence: code 4000:bb4b/4000:d55b store the f000:e585 result, victory path tests == 1; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: unlocked lure
fields.meaning: Lure index whose color was just unlocked (0xFF = none).
fields.evidence: code 4000:bdb7 stores the picked lure, 4000:bbad displays the reward; both natural saves = 0

fields.name: unknown
fields.meaning: Zero in both natural saves; no code references it.
fields.evidence: no direct reference seen; likely unused

fields.name: animation state
fields.meaning: Sprite animation timers left over from the screen shown when saving. No game meaning.
fields.evidence: code 4000:df2f/4000:df83; differs randomly between the two natural saves

fields.name: catch records
fields.meaning: 20 records of 12 bytes, sorted best first. Record: +0 fish kind (1-6+, low 4 bits), +1 mode-flags copy, +2/+4 two 16-bit size values (ranking keys), +6 lure id, +7 lure color, +8 map, +9 day, +10 time period (0/1/2), +11 weather. Empty (all zero) in both natural saves.
fields.evidence: code 4000:af5d builds each byte, f000:e145 sorts by +2 or +4, 4000:b08e inserts qualifying catches

fields.name: best catches
fields.meaning: 5 records of the same 12-byte form, sorted best first. Empty in both natural saves.
fields.evidence: code f000:e0b9 init, f000:e145 sorts, 4000:b08e inserts

fields.name: copy A check value
fields.meaning: XOR of the status byte and all 0x223 data bytes of copy A.
fields.evidence: code 4000:efcf writes, 4000:eeb8 checks; recomputed on both natural saves

fields.name: copy B status
fields.meaning: Same as copy A status.
fields.evidence: code 4000:edb5 writes both together

fields.name: copy B data
fields.meaning: Exact copy of copy A data, same layout shifted by 0x225.
fields.evidence: code 4000:efcf writes both copies; identical in both natural saves

fields.name: copy B check value
fields.meaning: XOR over copy B, same rule as copy A.
fields.evidence: code 4000:efcf, 4000:eeb8; recomputed on both natural saves

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: More working memory; not part of the save record.
fields.evidence: diffs between saves (changes every frame)

fields.name: not used
fields.meaning: Console owner data only; the game never writes it.
fields.evidence: identical between boot and both natural saves
